Class GroveBaseShield

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.GroveBaseShield
public final class GroveBaseShield extends Object
Pin map for the passive Grove Base Shield for UNO. The shield does not add a protocol or a runtime object: every socket is an ordinary UNO pin, so these constants can be passed directly to a Grove driver or to Gpio.

Use D4, for example, for the SIG wire of a Grove DHT module plugged into the shield's D4 socket. The module's GND and VCC wires are supplied by the socket; the driver only needs the signal pin.
